description.zh: 启用后是否重启网关，默认true
description.en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after the channel is enabled. The default value is `true`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb enable-polar-claw-channel --application-id pa-00000000000000 --channel-id feishu --restart true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb EnablePolarClawChannel --region cn-hangzhou --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000' --ChannelId feishu --Restart true
